stem: Which sentence should replace sentence 44 to bring this story to a more effective and creative closing?

options.label: A
options.text: “Most likely,” answered Julian, who was thinking quietly about his aunt and little cousin.

options.label: B
options.text: “Without a doubt!” Julian replied with a smile as he wiped an errant noodle from the ceiling.

options.label: C
options.text: “Maybe not!” countered Julian, but he noticed his mom was looking at him suspiciously.

options.label: D
options.text: “We’ll see,” Julian responded, pondering a host of topic ideas that he could share with his mom.

visual_elements: Multiple choice options labeled A, B, C, D with quoted sentences as answer choices.
